result.product: MAYBELLINE NEW YORK Superstay Matte Ink Liquid Lipstick, Warrior
result.why_chosen: Maybelline SuperStay Matte Ink is a highly rated product (4.3/5 stars from 89,422+ ratings on Flipkart) with proven long-lasting wear. The price of ₹320 (57% off from ₹749) is well within the ₹500 budget and offers excellent value for a premium international brand with strong user reviews.
result.why_others_rejected: On Amazon.in, many matte lipsticks under ₹500 were either sponsored ads from lesser-known brands, had significantly fewer reviews, or were priced near or above ₹500. Flipkart alternatives like Lakmé 9TO5 Primer + Matte Lipstick (₹217, 4.1 rating, 1.34L+ ratings) were also good, but the Maybelline SuperStay Matte Ink is a more globally trusted matte lipstick brand with a specific reputation for long-lasting matte finish that aligns best with the 'matte' requirement.
